candidate.answerReason: Substitution of x = -1 into the polynomial gives the remainder, (-1)^51 + 51 = 50.

methods.label: Make the divisor vanish
methods.explanation:
Because the divisor \(x+1\) has degree \(1\), the remainder is a constant \(r\). Write the division identity as
\[
x^{51}+51=(x+1)Q(x)+r,
\]
where \(Q(x)\) is the polynomial quotient. Setting \(x=-1\) makes the term containing the quotient vanish, leaving
\[
r=(-1)^{51}+51=-1+51=50.
\]
The remainder is \(\boxed{50}\), choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the polynomial division identity and evaluation at a negative integer.
